synthesis:draft.headline: Peak dispatch RRP in TAS1 was 450.08 $/MWh at 2026-08-06 13:00 AEST (UTC+1000).
summary: The high-price episode consisted of 1 five-minute interval at or above the analysis threshold of 300.0 $/MWh.
Dispatch TOTALDEMAND in that 5-minute interval (interval ending 2026-08-06 13:00 AEST (UTC+1000)): 1105.32 MW (dispatch TOTALDEMAND, 5-minute).

AEMO half-hour operational demand for the half-hour ending 2026-08-06 13:00 AEST (UTC+1000): 1147.0 MW; the window maximum operational demand was 1408.0 MW (interval ending 2026-08-06 19:00 AEST (UTC+1000)).
No AEMO market notice for TAS1 was returned by the public-notice search for the searched window.

possible_explanations.statement: The price spike might be associated with net export from TAS1 recorded at the peak interval (netinterchange value available for the same interval) [ev0436].
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Examine rebid history, unit availability and dispatch-instruction logs for 2026-08-06T03:00:00Z (2026-08-06 13:00 AEST (UTC+1000)) and check any market notices for that interval.

possible_explanations.statement: The spike might reflect a short-duration rebid or generator offer change concentrated in a single five-minute dispatch interval.
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Review offers and rebid records for the interval ending 2026-08-06T03:00:00Z (2026-08-06 13:00 AEST (UTC+1000)).

possible_explanations.statement: The spike might be related to changes in dispatch TOTALDEMAND around that interval (the dispatch TOTALDEMAND series shows values around the peak interval) [ev0435].
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Compare generation dispatch, bid/offer volumes and inverter output around 2026-08-06T03:00:00Z (2026-08-06 13:00 AEST (UTC+1000)).

uncertainties: Dispatch TOTALDEMAND (5-minute) and AEMO half-hour operational demand are different measures; the report gives both dispatch TOTALDEMAND (ev0435) and the half-hour operational demand (ev0897).

No market-notice text was returned by the public-notice search for TAS1 in the searched window; absence of a notice in the search does not prove that no internal dispatch instruction or rebid occurred.
